name: pi-next-native
description: PI NEXT (NSH): one app carrying both the native UI and the pi server + Node runtime it runs on

scripts.package:macos: nsh package --target macos --out ./release --name "PI NEXT" --icon ../build/icon-master.png && (strip -x "release/PI NEXT.app/Contents/MacOS/PINEXT" || true) && codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/PI NEXT.app"
scripts.dmg: npm run package:macos && S=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R "release/PI NEXT.app" "$S/" && ln -s /Applications "$S/Applications" && hdiutil create -volname "PI NEXT" -srcfolder "$S" -ov -format UDZO "release/PI-NEXT-0.1.0-arm64.dmg" && rm -rf "$S"
scripts.package:macos:full: nsh package --target macos --out ./release --name "PI NEXT" --icon ../build/icon-master.png && node scripts/bundle-app.mjs "release/PI NEXT.app" && (strip -x "release/PI NEXT.app/Contents/MacOS/PINEXT" || true) && codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/PI NEXT.app"
scripts.dmg:full: npm run package:macos:full && S=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R "release/PI NEXT.app" "$S/" && ln -s /Applications "$S/Applications" && hdiutil create -volname "PI NEXT" -srcfolder "$S" -ov -format UDZO "release/PI-NEXT-0.1.0-arm64-full.dmg" && rm -rf "$S"
